name: undesirables-mcp-server
summary: The Undesirables TCG Oracle as an MCP server: 27 focused tools for trading cards. Search 456K+ products (USD prices frozen 2026-09-07, dated in-band), market snapshots (suspended while frozen), AI grading, conformal-calibrated price forecasts with a public accuracy scorecard, card-collateral loan terms, fantasy and sports souls, all proven on-chain. Same tools as the hosted endpoint, over stdio. The local agent kit (memory, media, voice, code execution) ships as a second entry point.
